export_gif_frames: export a list of PIL images to an animated GIF file with configurable FPS
export_mesh_to_ply: export a 3D mesh with vertex colors and faces to a binary PLY file
export_mesh_to_obj: export a 3D mesh with vertex colors and faces to an OBJ file
export_video_frames: export a list of video frames to an MP4 video with configurable quality and bitrate
create_buffered_writer: create a context manager that wraps a raw file handle with buffered writing
